method: Independent model lexical/inflection review of every actual approved Spanish-sense/frame binding exposed by the bounded qualified-AGID diagnosis. Slot choices are literal tokens from the current pinned AGID row, tied to exact Spanish source kind, lemma record, zero-based sense/key and unchanged reviewed English frame. No global English-head whitelist or inferred regular spelling is authorized. Three-slot AGID V rows explicitly share their past/past-participle slot under the existing source parser convention; four-slot rows do not. Existing English predicate, subject, aspect, source grammar, usage, licensing and clause guards remain mandatory. Numeric AGID annotations are retained uninterpreted as evidence. This is one independent review/proposal, not production changes, native-human certification or verified additional word coverage.
